projectDescription: A domain-agnostic framework for automated user story implementation with Claude Code, providing reusable skills, parameterized templates, and automatic time tracking across 10 structured phases.
keyFeatures: 10-phase automated user story implementation workflow (BDD → code → tests → quality gates → report)
6 technology stack profiles: pyqt-mvc, fastapi-rest, flask-rest, flask-webapp, generic-python, hexagonal-ddd-bc
Automatic time tracking per phase and task with variance reporting
Parameterized template system with 35+ code snippets per stack
Quality gates validation: Pylint, cyclomatic complexity, maintainability index, coverage
Cross-platform installer (Linux, macOS, Windows) with interactive profile selection
publicApiSurface: /implement-us <US-ID> — main skill to run full 10-phase implementation workflow
/track-pause [reason] — pause time tracking with optional reason
/track-report <US-ID> — generate detailed time report for a user story
TimeTracker(us_id, us_title, us_points, producto) — core tracking class
Task(task_id, task_name, task_type, estimated_minutes) — task tracking dataclass
